hero.titleSuffix: to strengthen careers, projects and organisations.
hero.description: KRAAK Consulting works across three complementary areas of expertise, alongside a dedicated offer for organisations. Every engagement starts with a concrete need, a clear framework and an identifiable next step.

training.title: Help people present themselves with confidence, clarity and job-ready skills.
training.description: This area supports young people, students and early-career professionals who need to clarify their direction, strengthen their application toolkit and position themselves more effectively in the job market.
training.audience: Young people, students, early-career professionals and people repositioning themselves or changing careers.
training.challenge: You have potential but need to clarify your plans, strengthen your application toolkit and build confidence.
training.deliverables: Career guidance, CVs and cover letters in French and English, interview preparation, professional English and French, personal development workshops and transferable skills.
training.nextStep: Book an initial assessment to identify the right format: a short workshop, focused support or a more comprehensive programme.

projects.title: Structure an idea, mobilise the right resources and move a valuable project forward.
projects.description: This area supports businesses, start-ups, organisations and project leaders who need scoping, planning, partnerships or operational support to turn an intention into a manageable path forward.
projects.audience: Businesses, start-ups, organisations, associations and project leaders.
projects.challenge: You need to turn an idea into a clear, fundable and manageable project that can attract the right people.
projects.deliverables: Scoping and planning, partnership development, talent identification, support for businesses and start-ups, workplace preparation and placement.
projects.nextStep: Share your needs so we can define the scope, priorities and most useful form of support.

mobility.title: Prepare for international study, work and mobility with a clear method.
mobility.description: This area supports individuals and organisations that need to clarify an international plan, understand the available options and prepare appropriate steps for the profile, goal and destination.
mobility.complianceBody: the information provided in this context is intended to guide and prepare your plans. Official requirements may vary by country or programme and may change as procedures evolve.
mobility.audience: People seeking to study or work abroad, business opportunity seekers and organisations needing international guidance.
mobility.challenge: You need to clarify the options, understand the procedures and prepare plans that fit your profile.
mobility.deliverables: Strategic guidance, advice on studying and working abroad, exploration of business opportunities, immigration policies and strategies, and preparation for social and professional integration.
mobility.nextStep: Book a consultation to clarify your goal, target country and preparatory steps.

business.title: Targeted solutions for human capital, team cohesion and performance.
business.description: This dedicated offer is for organisations seeking to recruit more effectively, improve collaboration, strengthen internal leadership or raise organisational performance.
business.audience: SMEs, start-ups, organisations, leadership teams and HR teams.
business.challenge: You need to recruit and onboard more effectively, improve collaboration or help your teams progress.
business.deliverables: Talent identification, recruitment support, professional development workshops, staff training, organisational leadership, performance improvement and team cohesion.
business.nextStep: Tell us about your context to receive a tailored proposal or focused intervention.

offers.workplaceCulture: Workplace culture and healthy working relationships

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.updated: Last updated: May 2026. This policy explains how KRAAK Consulting protects personal data submitted through its public website, forms, email, WhatsApp or telephone communications, and lightweight audience-measurement tools.

controller.heading: Data controller
controller.prefix: The data controller is KRAAK Consulting, an organisation currently undergoing registration. For any request relating to your data, contact KRAAK Consulting at

collected.heading: Data we collect
collected.intro: We collect only the information necessary to understand and process your request:

items.identity: First name, last name or organisation name if you provide them
items.contact: Email address and telephone number provided voluntarily
items.request: Subject, category, context and content of your request
items.guidance: Information useful for the guidance requested, without a complete sensitive file
items.technical: Limited technical data related to security or audience measurement

purposes.heading: Purposes and legal bases
purposes.body: Your data is used to respond to your requests, provide appropriate guidance, arrange a discussion where necessary, secure the website and improve the clarity of the public user journey. The legal bases relied upon are your consent when you contact us voluntarily, KRAAK Consulting's legitimate interest in processing and following up requests and, where necessary, steps taken before entering into a contract or compliance with a legal obligation.

contactConsent.heading: Consent when contacting us
contactConsent.body: When you submit a form, send an email or WhatsApp message, or call KRAAK Consulting, you consent to KRAAK Consulting using the information provided to assess your request, respond to you and provide reasonable follow-up. You may withdraw this consent or request that follow-up stop at any time using the contact details provided on this page.

sharing.heading: Data sharing
sharing.body: KRAAK Consulting does not sell your personal data. It is not disclosed to third parties for commercial purposes. It may only be shared with technical service providers necessary for operation of the website, contact tools, hosting, security or audience measurement, or where disclosure is required by law.

retention.heading: Retention period
retention.body: Data from forms, emails, calls and contact messages is retained for 3 years from the last meaningful interaction, unless a valid deletion request applies, a legal obligation requires otherwise, or evidence relating to an ongoing exchange needs to be retained.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.intro: Depending on the applicable law, you may request:

items.erasure: Erasure of data that no longer needs to be retained
items.restriction: Restriction of or objection to certain processing activities
items.portability: Portability of data you have provided
items.withdrawal: Withdrawal of your consent for the relevant processing activities

rights.contactPrefix: To exercise these rights, write to
rights.complaint: You may also lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority if you believe your rights have not been respected.

analytics.heading: Cookies and audience measurement
analytics.prefix: The website intentionally places no advertising cookies. Google Analytics 4 may be enabled only when a
analytics.suffix: identifier is configured for the relevant environment; otherwise, no Google Analytics script is loaded. When audience measurement is active, it is used to produce aggregated statistics about public-site navigation, with IP anonymization configured on the website. You can limit or block cookies and measurement identifiers through your browser settings.

hosting.heading: Hosting and technical transfers
hosting.body: The website and API are hosted by Render Services, Inc. The database, authentication and storage are provided by Supabase Inc. These providers may process technical data necessary for hosting, security and service availability. Where transfers outside your country of residence are necessary, KRAAK Consulting relies on the contractual and technical safeguards offered by its providers.

sensitive.heading: Limits on sensitive requests
sensitive.body: The public website is not intended for submitting complete administrative applications, identity documents, financial supporting documents or sensitive data. If an in-depth review becomes necessary, KRAAK Consulting will indicate the appropriate channel and the information strictly necessary to provide.

cta.heading: Have questions about your data?
cta.body: Contact us to exercise your rights or obtain information about how your data is processed.

hero.title: Useful answers to help you move forward with greater clarity.
hero.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our services, programs, support arrangements and response times. If your needs are specific, we will guide you directly.

orientation.title: Quick guidance
orientation.description: Clarify your needs before investing time or energy in the wrong direction.

international.title: International outlook
international.description: Programs, projects and mobility: we structure realistic, progressive pathways.

practical.title: Practical answers
practical.description: We prioritize concise, actionable answers connected to your next useful step.

closing.title: Can't find the answer you need?
closing.description: Tell us about your situation. We will help you identify the right entry point based on your needs, profile and objectives.

accompanimentChoice.question: How do I choose the right KRAAK support option?
accompanimentChoice.answer: We start with your objective, your level of readiness and your main constraint. From there, we guide you toward the right entry point: a service, program, consultation or tailored support.

gettingStarted.question: How do I get started with KRAAK?
gettingStarted.answerBeforeEmail: You can submit a request through the contact form, write to
gettingStarted.answerAfterEmail: or start an initial conversation on WhatsApp. To speed up the guidance process, include your objective, country, timeline and the type of support you are looking for.

remoteSupport.question: Is KRAAK support available remotely?
remoteSupport.answer: Yes. Guidance discussions and some support services can be delivered remotely. The exact format - remote, hybrid or in person - is confirmed before starting, depending on the service, audience and project constraints.

audiences.question: Do you work only with individuals?
audiences.answer: No. KRAAK also supports teams, organizations, associations, institutions and businesses with training, guidance, project structuring, recruitment and team-cohesion needs.

responseTime.question: How long does it take to receive a response after contacting you?
responseTime.answer: Every request submitted through the form or by email receives an initial response within 48 business hours. This first response confirms the appropriate direction, requests useful additional information if needed, or proposes an appointment.

internationalMobility.question: Can you help with an immigration or international mobility project?
internationalMobility.answer: Yes. KRAAK supports the clarification, preparation and guidance of study, work, travel and international business-opportunity projects according to the profile and intended destination.

guarantees.question: Does KRAAK guarantee a visa, job or admission?
guarantees.answer: No. KRAAK supports the preparation, structuring and guidance of these processes, but final decisions are made by the relevant institutions, employers, schools, authorities or organizations.

earlyStage.question: Do I need a fully developed project before contacting you?
earlyStage.answer: No. You can contact us from the idea stage. Our role also includes helping you clarify the next useful step before a project is fully formalized.

contactData.question: How is my contact information used?
contactData.answer: Information submitted through the form is used only to process your contact and information request. It is neither sold nor shared with third parties for commercial purposes and is retained for 3 years from the last interaction, then deleted.
